name: Congenital Autosomal Recessive Small-Platelet Thrombocytopenia

diagnosticCriteria.formalCriteriaName: Diagnostic Criteria for Congenital Autosomal Recessive Small-Platelet Thrombocytopenia

criteria.description: Persistent thrombocytopenia with platelet counts below 50 x 10^9/L
Presence of small platelets (reduced mean platelet volume) on peripheral blood smear
Identification of biallelic pathogenic variants in associated gene(s) confirming autosomal recessive inheritance
Exclusion of acquired causes of thrombocytopenia and other inherited platelet disorders

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: All three major criteria (persistent thrombocytopenia, small platelet size, and genetic confirmation) must be met for diagnosis.
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Diagnosis requires careful exclusion of other inherited and acquired thrombocytopenias.

pathognomonic.symptomName: Persistent thrombocytopenia with platelet count <50 x 10^9/L
Small platelet size (microplatelets) on peripheral smear

common.symptomName: Mucocutaneous bleeding tendency (e.g., epistaxis, gingival bleeding)
searchTerms: bleeding from skin and mucous membranes
bleeding lasts long after small cuts

occasional.symptomName: Mild anemia secondary to chronic bleeding
searchTerms: mild low red blood cells from bleeding
anemia caused by chronic blood loss
slight anemia due to ongoing bleeding
fatigue related to low red blood cells

laboratory: Severe thrombocytopenia with platelet counts typically <50 x 10^9/L
Peripheral blood smear showing small platelets (microplatelets)
Normal to mildly reduced platelet aggregation studies
genetic: Biallelic pathogenic variants in gene(s) associated with autosomal recessive small-platelet thrombocytopenia
other: Bone marrow biopsy typically shows normal or increased megakaryocytes

distinguishingFeatures: Giant platelets rather than small platelets
Small platelets but associated with eczema and immunodeficiency

redFlags: Intracranial hemorrhage or other life-threatening bleeding
Failure to respond to standard immune thrombocytopenia treatments
references: Orphanet: Congenital autosomal recessive small-platelet thrombocytopenia - ORPHA:566192
